Alchemists

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Alchemists

Alchemy is a craft. While many wizards are alchemists, alchemy does not require spellcasting.

Practice

*The elementalists and alchemists of the Idjits can harness electricity to make hybrid creatures. They have weaponised shock lizards and created cloud mantas capable of propelling ships. *Alchemists discovered the main component of the Scent Barrier in the caverns beneath Jahur. They create the pungent network of geysers that blasts a range of strong smells that makes those reliant on scent disoriented, then half-blind and insane. *Quicksilver emulsifies certain magical potions, can cause unstable reactions, including twisting people to become silverlings. Some unscrupulous alchemists use silverling body parts in their formulae.
*Jahuri alchemists make blackpowder and fertiliser from the guano of sea birds. *The alka-lion drips a powerful solvent sought out by alchemists (14.27). *Master Var has developed a substance from ochre jelly that makes his skin mostly fireproof. *Jiffon Soon created the geas-eater to remove from himself a powerful curse. *An opportunistic alchemist captured a mating pair of fire centipedes (17.30). *Orhan, in happier times, turned lead to gold. He also grew his own wives in vats and had a gnoll sing souls into them. While one of Orhan’s wives had her body shattered in a recent attack, his apprentices have preserved the brain. **The Lady grew a vat-creature, Zor.

Alchemists

*Master Var is “something of” an alchemist. *Jiffon Soon, an exile of Naros, is a mad alchemist. *The Idjits *Viceroy Orhan was chosen as treasurer because of his skill at alchemy. *There is a gnome alchemist in The Fearless. *Severard had an alchemy lab. *Many alchemists now study alongside hexers and astrologers at the Imperial Academy of Thaumaturgy, which once taught wizards and sages.
